title: Disney+ looks to TikTok creators to bring fan content to its short-form video feed | TechCrunch
summary: Disney is partnering with TikTok to bring Disney-focused fan content directly into the Disney+ app. This competition is partly why Disney launched the Verts feature in the first place, along with Netflix , HBO Max , and Prime Video .
